en.title: Opening a business bank account in Singapore and ASEAN hubs
en.standfirst: How to open a corporate bank account in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia, including KYC rules, digital account providers and operational substance checks.
en.metaDescription: How to open a corporate bank account in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia: entity documents, KYC and beneficial ownership checks, and digital providers.
en.body:
Opening a business bank account is an important step in establishing ASEAN operations. Preparation involves more than selecting a provider: the institution must understand the company, its owners and its proposed transactions.

Whether you need to **open a business bank account in Singapore**, establish a **corporate bank account in Malaysia**, or arrange a **PT PMA bank account in Indonesia**, prepare for **ASEAN KYC requirements** early.

## Entity requirements first

For the local company routes covered here, begin with the relevant incorporation and registration documents: ACRA records in Singapore, SSM registration in Malaysia, or the Indonesian PT PMA's corporate documents.

Those records establish which entity is applying and who may act on its behalf. A home-country business registration alone does not replace the documents required for a local company's application.

However, local incorporation should not be presented as a universal prerequisite for every account product. DBS, for example, also accepts enquiries from foreign-incorporated companies, subject to its assessment. [DBS: Accounts for foreign-owned companies](https://www.dbs.com.sg/sme/day-to-day/accounts/foreign-owned-companies)

Confirm that the selected provider accepts your entity type before preparing the application.

## KYC and anti-money laundering

Know Your Customer, or KYC, checks help the institution establish who owns and controls the business and understand how the account will be used.

Prepare the corporate registration records, account-opening authority and identity documents requested for directors, signatories and ultimate beneficial owners.

For companies with several ownership layers, provide a clear explanation of the structure. DBS's document checklist requests reliable evidence identifying beneficial ownership and control, and notes that further documents may be required. [DBS: Account-opening document checklist](https://www.dbs.com.sg/documents/1038650/59715311/Account-Opening-Checklist-feb-2022.pdf/b0a83a54-9ef6-cb4a-48c6-cb34f41dd1be?t=1644391971150)

A clear business plan should also explain the source of funds, intended customers and expected transactions.

## Singapore: traditional and digital banks

Traditional banks and digital business account providers may serve different operational needs.

Assess the functions your business requires, including payments, foreign currency transactions and access to credit or trade finance. Check eligibility and approval requirements directly with each provider.

Also confirm the provider's regulatory status. A digital business account is not necessarily a bank account: Airwallex describes its Singapore entity as a licensed payment institution rather than a bank. [Airwallex: Singapore regulatory status](https://www.airwallex.com/en-sg/blog/is-airwallex-safe)

Avoid treating advertised onboarding speed as a guaranteed approval date. Foreign ownership, complex structures and additional document requests can affect the application process.

## Proving operational substance

Be prepared to explain the commercial purpose of the company and its planned local activities.

Supporting material may include the leases, invoices or hiring plans requested by the institution. Ensure those documents accurately reflect the business's actual position and plans.

Before applying:

1. Assemble the relevant corporate records.
2. Identify the ultimate beneficial owners.
3. Explain the business model and source of funds.
4. Prepare evidence supporting the intended activities.
5. Confirm any interview or verification appointment requirements.

The Monetary Authority of Singapore and Bank Negara Malaysia oversee their respective domestic regulatory frameworks. The selected institution remains the practical contact for its account eligibility, document checklist and approval process.

zh.title: 在新加坡及東協樞紐開立企業銀行帳戶
zh.standfirst: 如何在新加坡、馬來西亞與印尼開立公司銀行帳戶，包括 KYC 規定、數位帳戶服務商與營運實質審查。
zh.metaDescription: 在新加坡、馬來西亞與印尼開立公司銀行帳戶的方法：公司文件、KYC 與實質受益人審查、數位服務商與營運實質。
zh.body:
開立企業銀行帳戶是建立東協營運的重要步驟。準備工作不只是選擇服務商：金融機構必須了解這家公司、其所有人及其擬進行的交易。

無論您需要**在新加坡開立企業銀行帳戶**、設立**馬來西亞公司銀行帳戶**，或安排**印尼 PT PMA 銀行帳戶**，都應及早為**東協 KYC 要求**做好準備。

## 先滿足實體要求

就本指南所涵蓋的本地公司途徑而言，先從相關的公司登記文件著手：新加坡的 ACRA 登記紀錄、馬來西亞的 SSM 登記，或印尼 PT PMA 的公司文件。

這些紀錄用於確認申請的實體是誰，以及誰有權代表該實體行事。僅憑母國的營利事業登記，並不能取代本地公司申請所需的文件。

不過，不應將本地公司登記視為每一種帳戶產品的通用前提。例如，DBS 也接受外國註冊公司的諮詢，但須經其評估。[DBS：外資公司帳戶](https://www.dbs.com.sg/sme/day-to-day/accounts/foreign-owned-companies)

在準備申請之前，先確認所選服務商接受您的實體類型。

## KYC 與反洗錢

「認識你的客戶」（Know Your Customer，KYC）審查協助金融機構確認誰擁有並控制這家企業，並了解帳戶的使用方式。

準備公司登記紀錄、開戶授權文件，以及董事、簽署人與最終實質受益人所需的身分文件。

對於持股層級較多的公司，請清楚說明其架構。DBS 的文件清單要求提供可靠的證據以辨識實質受益所有權與控制權，並註明可能要求提供進一步文件。[DBS：開戶文件清單](https://www.dbs.com.sg/documents/1038650/59715311/Account-Opening-Checklist-feb-2022.pdf/b0a83a54-9ef6-cb4a-48c6-cb34f41dd1be?t=1644391971150)

清楚的營運計畫也應說明資金來源、目標客戶及預期交易。

## 新加坡：傳統銀行與數位銀行

傳統銀行與數位企業帳戶服務商可能滿足不同的營運需求。

評估您的企業所需的功能，包括付款、外幣交易，以及取得信貸或貿易融資。請直接向各服務商確認資格與核准要求。

也要確認服務商的監理身分。數位企業帳戶不一定是銀行帳戶：Airwallex 將其新加坡實體描述為持牌支付機構，而非銀行。[Airwallex：新加坡監理身分](https://www.airwallex.com/en-sg/blog/is-airwallex-safe)

不要將廣告中的開戶速度視為保證的核准日期。外資持股、複雜架構及補件要求都可能影響申請流程。

## 證明營運實質

準備好說明公司的商業目的及其計畫中的本地業務活動。

佐證資料可能包括金融機構要求的租約、發票或招聘計畫。請確保這些文件準確反映企業的實際狀況與計畫。

申請之前：

1. 整理相關的公司紀錄。
2. 確認最終實質受益人。
3. 說明商業模式與資金來源。
4. 準備支持預定業務活動的證據。
5. 確認是否有面談或驗證預約的要求。

新加坡金融管理局（Monetary Authority of Singapore）與馬來西亞國家銀行（Bank Negara Malaysia）分別監督各自的國內監理框架。所選金融機構仍是帳戶資格、文件清單與核准流程的實際聯絡窗口。
